items.name: accent-picker
items.title: Accent Picker
items.description: Accent swatches as a native radio group, plus an optional custom color.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Single or multiple disclosure panels.

items.name: action-bar
items.title: Action Bar
items.description: A floating toolbar for bulk actions on a selection, turning up from the bottom edge.

items.name: activity-feed
items.title: Activity Feed
items.description: A timeline of events: who did what to which thing, and when, grouped under a heading per day. Times are real `<time>` elements. Server-safe; pass `now` so server and client agree on which day is "Today".

items.name: add-to-cart-button
items.title: Add To Cart Button
items.description: A primary "Add to cart" that morphs idle → spinner → check → idle around an async `onAdd`. Every label is stacked in one grid cell, so the button keeps its width through the morph.

items.name: address-form
items.title: Address Form
items.description: Address fields that relabel and reorder for the chosen country (ZIP, postcode or PIN code, state or county, postal code before city), with full autocomplete tokens and the second address line tucked behind a link.

items.name: agent-trace
items.title: Agent Trace
items.description: How an agent reached its answer: each tool call with its status, its time and, on demand, its result.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A prominent message. Danger and warning interrupt as role="alert"; other tones wait their turn as role="status". Server-safe.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal that interrupts for a decision. It never closes on a backdrop click.

items.name: anchor-nav
items.title: Anchor Nav
items.description: A horizontal in-page section bar: scrollspy, a pill that slides to the current section, and the current link kept in view when the bar overflows on small screens.

items.name: animated-beam
items.title: Animated Beam
items.description: A pulse of light that travels along a curved path between two elements, for integration diagrams and data flow. The path is measured from the elements and re-measured on resize. Decorative: hidden from assistive tech, and the pulse stops under reduced motion.

items.name: animated-list
items.title: Animated List
items.description: Items arrive one at a time and spring into place while the list opens room for them, like a live feed. Starts once the list scrolls into view; under reduced motion all items show.

items.name: announcement-bar
items.title: Announcement Bar
items.description: Site-wide promo strip following the APG carousel pattern: rotation pauses on hover and focus, a visible pause control satisfies WCAG 2.2.2, and messages slide vertically.

items.name: api-key-field
items.title: API Key Field
items.description: An API key row: masked value, reveal, copy and a confirmed regenerate.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: Sidebar, header and main region with a skip link.

items.name: appearance-preview
items.title: Appearance Preview
items.description: A working miniature of an app, drawn entirely in the library's tokens, so it shows what a theme, accent, radius, density or font choice will look like before it is applied. Server-component safe.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Holds a width-to-height ratio; its child fills the box, so embeds and maps never jump.

items.name: audit-log
items.title: Audit Log
items.description: Who did what, when: security and admin events grouped by day. Server-safe.

items.name: aurora
items.title: Aurora
items.description: Slow, heavily blurred ribbons of light. Each layer drifts on its own transform-only loop, so the compositor does the work and the page never repaints. Pure CSS: server-component safe.

items.name: autocomplete
items.title: Autocomplete
items.description: A free-text field with suggestions. Unlike Combobox the value is whatever is typed; a suggestion only fills it in.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Initials from a name, with status and groups.

items.name: avatar-upload
items.title: Avatar Upload
items.description: A round photo with a change button over it and a remove button beside it.

items.name: back-in-stock-form
items.title: Back In Stock Form
items.description: Sold-out replacement for the buy button: reveals an email field and confirms the alert.

items.name: back-to-top
items.title: Back To Top
items.description: Appears after scrolling, rings its edge with reading progress, and returns to the top.

items.name: background-beams
items.title: Background Beams
items.description: Gently curved beams with light running along them: each light is a single dash on a path normalised with `pathLength`, travelling through a gradient that spans the frame. CSS keyframes only, server-component safe; under reduced motion each light rests at a seeded point.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A compact label for status, counts and merchandising flags such as “New” or “−20%”.

items.name: ball-pit
items.title: Ball Pit
items.description: A small physics toy: balls fall, stack and collide, and the pointer shoves them around. Plain canvas 2D with a fixed-step solver. Under reduced motion it renders the settled pile once.

items.name: barcode
items.title: Barcode
items.description: A Code 128 barcode as crisp SVG, encoded without dependencies. Server-safe.

items.name: bento-light
items.title: Bento Light
items.description: A bento grid lit by one light that travels across it: every cell knows where the pointer is in its own box, so edges glow on whichever cells the pointer nears, neighbours included. A single listener on the grid, one write per cell per frame, no re-renders.

items.name: billing-usage
items.title: Billing Usage
items.description: Metered usage for the current billing period, with a ring for time left. Server-safe.

items.name: bleed
items.title: Bleed
items.description: Lets a child escape its container's padding, for edge-to-edge images and bands.

items.name: bokeh
items.title: Bokeh
items.description: Out-of-focus discs of light floating in front of the lens. Seeded positions, sizes and drift, all on transform and opacity loops. Server-component safe.

items.name: border-beam
items.title: Border Beam
items.description: A beam of ink that travels around the border of its nearest positioned ancestor. Place it as the last child of any `position: relative` container; it inherits the container's radius.

items.name: bottom-navigation
items.title: Bottom Navigation
items.description: A mobile tab bar: three to five destinations with a sliding active pill.

items.name: bottom-sheet
items.title: Bottom Sheet
items.description: Owns the open state. Renders no element of its own.

items.name: bounce-cards
items.title: Bounce Cards
items.description: A fanned hand of cards that bounce in one by one. Hovering or focusing a card straightens and lifts it while its neighbours lean away to make room.

items.name: box
items.title: Box
items.description: The base layout block: padding, surface, radius, border and shadow from tokens.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Server-safe: only a collapsed breadcrumb hydrates its small expand button.

items.name: breadcrumb-menu
items.title: Breadcrumb Menu
items.description: A breadcrumb trail whose middle crumbs fold into a dropdown menu once the trail is long. The last crumb is the current page.

items.name: bundle-builder
items.title: Bundle Builder
items.description: "Frequently bought together": product thumbnails joined by plus signs, tick boxes and a live total.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Six variants, three sizes and a stable loading state.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Groups related buttons under one accessible name. Pass `aria-label` to name the group.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid following the APG date picker pattern: one tab stop, arrows move by day and week, Page keys by month (Shift for year), Home and End to the week's edges.

items.name: calendar-view
items.title: Calendar View
items.description: A month grid (WAI-ARIA grid: arrows move by day and week, Page Up/Down by month, Home/End to the week's edges) and a week agenda, both fed by one list of events.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A composable surface with header, media and footer.

items.name: card-swap
items.title: Card Swap
items.description: A skewed 3D stack that drops its front card out of view and slides it in at the back, on a loop. Only the front card is interactive; the stack is one tab stop whose arrow keys deal the next or previous card. The loop idles offscreen and stops under reduced motion.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Product rails with real physics: native scroll-snap with mouse drag and momentum, a 3D coverflow driven by scroll-timeline (with a JS fallback), or a fanned stack. Follows the APG carousel pattern, including a pause control for autoplay.

items.name: cart
items.title: Cart
items.description: Headless cart state with persistence and undo.

items.name: cart-button
items.title: Cart Button
items.description: The header cart icon. It is the `[data-cart-target]` that fly-to-cart animations land on, its badge pops when the count goes up, and inside a `CartProvider` it opens the cart.

items.name: cart-drawer
items.title: Cart Drawer
items.description: The slide-out cart. Inside a `CartProvider` it needs no props; every piece of state can also be passed explicitly to drive it from your own store.

items.name: cascader
items.title: Cascader
items.description: Picks a path through nested options one column at a time, like region, city and district. Right or Enter opens a branch, Left steps back, Enter on a leaf picks the whole path.

items.name: center
items.title: Center
items.description: A column centred horizontally with a readable maximum width.

items.name: changelog-list
items.title: Changelog List
items.description: Product updates, newest first, with the date on a rail and typed change tags. Server-safe.

items.name: chat-message
items.title: Chat Message
items.description: One user, assistant or system turn.

items.name: chat-thread
items.title: Chat Thread
items.description: The scrolling conversation. It sticks to the bottom while new messages and streamed words arrive, stops following the moment the reader scrolls up, and offers a way back down.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox with an indeterminate state and groups.

items.name: checkbox-card
items.title: Checkbox Card
items.description: A native checkbox drawn as a selectable card, for add-ons and multi-choice settings. The whole card is the label, so it keeps form submission, reset and autofill. Server-safe.

items.name: checkout-form
items.title: Checkout Form
items.description: One-page checkout in numbered sections: contact, shipping address, delivery speed and payment. Errors are shown inline after a submit attempt and focus moves to the first one.

items.name: checkout-steps
items.title: Checkout Steps
items.description: A checkout progress stepper with animated connectors and a compact mobile summary.

items.name: chip-list
items.title: Chip List
items.description: A read-only set of chips that folds the overflow into an expandable “+N”.

items.name: choice-list
items.title: Choice List
items.description: A single choice presented as cards: plans, report periods, export formats. Native radio inputs underneath, so arrow keys, forms and validation behave as the platform does.

items.name: circular-gallery
items.title: Circular Gallery
items.description: Panels arranged on a 3D ring that turns slowly, can be flung by dragging, and steps one panel at a time with the arrow keys. The ring's radius comes from CSS trigonometry, so it always fits the panel count.

items.name: circular-text
items.title: Circular Text
items.description: Text set on a circle that turns slowly and speeds up or reverses under the pointer. The text is stretched to exactly one circumference (`textLength`), so it closes seamlessly whatever the font. Server-safe: rotation and hover are pure CSS, and screen readers get the text once.

items.name: clamp
items.title: Clamp
items.description: Clamps content to a number of lines with a soft fade, and offers a toggle only when the content actually overflows.

items.name: click-spark
items.title: Click Spark
items.description: Wraps any content and throws a small burst of sparks from every press, drawn on a canvas that sits above the content without intercepting events. Off under reduced motion.

items.name: cluster
items.title: Cluster
items.description: Items of any width that wrap as they need to, such as tags, buttons or meta.

items.name: code
items.title: Code
items.description: Inline code: a mono run on a soft paper chip that scales with the text around it.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A code sample with copy, line numbers and highlighted lines. The scroll region is focusable so keyboard users can scroll long lines.

items.name: code-tabs
items.title: Code Tabs
items.description: One code sample in several flavours (npm, pnpm, yarn; or file per tab), with a shared copy.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A single disclosure: one trigger shows and hides one region.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A dependency-free color picker: a saturation and brightness area, hue and opacity sliders, a hex field and optional presets. Every part is a keyboard slider with spoken values.

items.name: columns
items.title: Columns
items.description: A side column and a main column that stack on their own when space runs out, with no media queries: the layout reacts to its own width.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: An APG editable combobox with list autocomplete. Focus stays in the input; the active option is conveyed with `aria-activedescendant`. The value is always one of the options.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: Grouped, searchable commands in a dialog.

items.name: comment-thread
items.title: Comment Thread
items.description: A discussion with nested replies on a rail, inline reply boxes and collapsible branches.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: Comparison Table
items.description: Features down, options across, with yes/no marks that read as words. Server-safe.

items.name: confetti
items.title: Confetti
items.description: Physics confetti on a top-layer canvas.

items.name: confirm-button
items.title: Confirm Button
items.description: Press twice or hold to confirm.

items.name: container
items.title: Container
items.description: The page column: a centred maximum width with side padding. It is also a size container, so a `Grid` or `Show` inside responds to its width.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Owns the open state and the pointer position the menu opens at. Renders no element.

items.name: cookie-banner
items.title: Cookie Banner
items.description: Consent banner with Accept and Reject given equal weight on the first layer, as EU regulators expect, and a preferences view with one switch per category.

items.name: copy-field
items.title: Copy Field
items.description: A read-only value with a copy button: install commands, IDs, URLs.

items.name: countdown
items.title: Countdown
items.description: A sale or shipping-cutoff timer. The server and first client render show a stable placeholder; ticking starts after mount, aligned to whole seconds, and pauses while the tab is hidden.

items.name: counter
items.title: Counter
items.description: A live figure that tweens from its previous value whenever `value` changes, for KPIs that refresh in place. Built on `NumberTicker`, so it formats with Intl, reserves its width and exposes only the final value to assistive tech. Snaps under reduced motion.

items.name: coupon-input
items.title: Coupon Input
items.description: Discount-code field with async validation, a removable applied tag and announced results.

items.name: credit-card-input
items.title: Credit Card Input
items.description: Card number, expiry and security code in one field. The number groups by brand, fails the Luhn check visibly, and focus moves on as each part fills.

items.name: crosshair
items.title: Crosshair
items.description: Hairlines that track the pointer across an area, like a measuring tool. The lines are moved by CSS variables written once per frame, so the area never re-renders.

items.name: cube-field
items.title: Cube Field
items.description: An isometric field of CSS 3D cubes with a slow wave rising through it, diagonal by diagonal. Three faces per cube, `transform` only. Server-component safe.

items.name: currency-input
items.title: Currency Input
items.description: An amount field: the symbol sits outside the editable text, digits follow the currency's minor units, and the amount is grouped in the user's locale once they leave the field.

items.name: currency-selector
items.title: Currency Selector
items.description: Store currency picker built on Select, with localized names and a symbol badge per option.

items.name: curved-loop
items.title: Curved Loop
items.description: A phrase that travels along a curved SVG path like a ribbon, repeating seamlessly. The offset is written to the textPath attribute per frame, never through React state.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: A native table with sortable headers (`aria-sort`), optional row selection, sticky header, three densities and zebra rows. Columns are plain data with optional render functions, and sorting runs on the client unless `manualSort` is set.

items.name: date-input
items.title: Date Input
items.description: The browser's own date field, themed: native keyboard entry, locale order and picker on every platform, plus a clear button.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A field that opens a Calendar in a popover. Single days or ranges.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date Range Picker
items.description: Two native date fields and one-tap presets. Typing a date never emits a half-finished or backwards range: a change is reported only once both ends are set and in order.

items.name: date-time-field
items.title: Date Time Field
items.description: Typed date and time segments in the locale's order, plus an optional calendar popup.

items.name: delivery-estimate
items.title: Delivery Estimate
items.description: "Get it by Thu, Oct 30" with cutoff urgency, business-day math and a mini timeline.

items.name: delta
items.title: Delta
items.description: A signed change: arrow, magnitude and a spoken direction, toned by whether the move is good. Colour is never the only channel. Server-safe and locale-free, so SSR and hydration agree.

items.name: deploy-status
items.title: Deploy Status
items.description: Build and deploy steps as a pipeline: each node turns as its step runs. Server-safe.

items.name: description-list
items.title: Description List
items.description: Labelled values in a semantic `<dl>`, grouped per pair so each term stays with its value.

items.name: deviation-rows
items.title: Deviation Rows
items.description: Signed gaps as bars that grow from zero, one row per item, with the figure in words beside each bar. When every gap falls on one side the zero line moves to that edge, so the rail is used in full. Server-safe.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Owns the open state. Renders no element of its own.

items.name: diff-view
items.title: Diff View
items.description: A line-level diff of two strings, unified or side by side, computed in the browser.

items.name: dither
items.title: Dither
items.description: A flowing gradient field rendered through an ordered (Bayer) dither at a coarse pixel size, like a print or an early screen. Three tones, written straight into an ImageData buffer at the dither resolution, so it costs a fraction of a full-resolution canvas.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: A macOS-style dock. Items grow with pointer proximity through springs; neighbours are pushed aside with transforms, and the backdrop widens with a clip-path, so nothing triggers layout.

items.name: dot-field
items.title: Dot Field
items.description: A field of dots that swell, light up and part around the pointer, then spring back. Canvas, DPR-capped, paused offscreen; under reduced motion the dots still respond, without easing.

items.name: dot-pagination
items.title: Dot Pagination
items.description: Compact page dots for carousels and onboarding. A single bead glides between dots; arrow keys move and select, so the group is one tab stop.

items.name: dot-pattern
items.title: Dot Pattern
items.description: An SVG dot grid. Static by default and server-component safe; `glow` mounts a small client part that lights the dots around the pointer through CSS variables, without re-rendering.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Owns the open state. Renders no element of its own.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Owns the open state of an APG menu button. Renders no element.

items.name: dynamic-island
items.title: Dynamic Island
items.description: A pill that morphs between live states.

items.name: elastic-slider
items.title: Elastic Slider
items.description: A slider whose track stretches like a rubber band when dragged past either end and springs back on release. Keyboard follows the WAI-ARIA slider pattern; the stretch is off under reduced motion.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: What a list, table or cart shows when there is nothing in it yet. Server-safe.

items.name: environment-switcher
items.title: Environment Switcher
items.description: A radio group for the environment a view targets. A sliding thumb carries the selection and each environment keeps its tone, so production always reads as production.

items.name: falling-text
items.title: Falling Text
items.description: Words that drop out of a sentence and pile up at the bottom of their box with a little bounce. A column-height model stands in for a physics engine, so landed words stack.

items.name: feature-comparison
items.title: Feature Comparison
items.description: Plan-by-feature matrix with grouped rows, a sticky header and a highlighted column.

items.name: feature-flag-list
items.title: Feature Flag List
items.description: Feature flags with one switch for the environment in view and a tag per environment, so drift between staging and production is visible at a glance.

items.name: fetch-progress
items.title: Fetch Progress
items.description: A hairline progress bar along the top edge, for background fetches and route changes.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Label, description and error for any control.

items.name: file-dropzone
items.title: File Dropzone
items.description: A drop target with a real button for browsing, type and size checks, image previews and a progress row per file. Drive `items` to show upload progress from your own uploader.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File Tree
items.description: A file explorer built on `TreeView`: give it paths, get folders, icons and git markers.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter Bar
items.description: The filters a view is drawn under: a scope menu, one removable chip per applied filter and a reset. Chips are a labelled list, each remove button names the filter it clears.

items.name: filter-chips
items.title: Filter Chips
items.description: Toggle-button filters for collection pages, with counts, a check animation and Clear all.

items.name: filter-sheet
items.title: Filter Sheet
items.description: A side sheet of filter fields with a sticky apply and reset footer, built on Drawer.

items.name: flip-card
items.title: Flip Card
items.description: A two-faced card that flips in 3D on a spring. Its height follows the taller face, the hidden face is inert, and under reduced motion the faces crossfade instead of rotating.

items.name: floating-action-button
items.title: Floating Action Button
items.description: The screen's primary action, pinned to a corner.

items.name: flowing-menu
items.title: Flowing Menu
items.description: Full-width menu rows. Hovering a row floods it from the edge the pointer came through with an accent band carrying a marquee of the label, and drains it toward the edge it leaves by.

items.name: folder
items.title: Folder
items.description: A folder that tips its front flap open and fans its papers up. It is a toggle button; hovering lets the papers peek out first.

items.name: font-picker
items.title: Font Picker
items.description: Typefaces as a native radio list, each previewed in its own face.

items.name: form-wizard
items.title: Form Wizard
items.description: A multi-step form: a step rail, one panel at a time, and Back and Continue that run each step's `validate` first. Focus moves to the new step's heading so the change is announced.

items.name: formatted-number
items.title: Formatted Number
items.description: A number formatted with `Intl.NumberFormat`, wrapped in `<data>` with the raw value.

items.name: frame
items.title: Frame
items.description: A media frame: crops any image or video to a ratio, with a radius and an inner ink edge.

items.name: free-shipping-progress
items.title: Free Shipping Progress
items.description: Cart nudge toward a free-shipping threshold. Server-safe; the bar animates with CSS only.

items.name: getting-started-cards
items.title: Getting Started Cards
items.description: Next-step cards for an empty workspace, numbered on an orbit and linking out. Server-safe.

items.name: gift-card
items.title: Gift Card
items.description: A physical-looking gift card with a masked code you can reveal and copy.

items.name: glare-hover
items.title: Glare Hover
items.description: A surface that catches a band of light sweeping across it when hovered or focused within. Pure CSS on a pseudo element, so it is server-safe and never covers the content's events.

items.name: glass-panel
items.title: Glass Panel
items.description: A frosted glass surface: backdrop blur with saturation, a surface tint, a hairline edge that catches light along the top and an optional grain. The building block for panels laid over any of the backgrounds. Server-component safe.

items.name: glitch-text
items.title: Glitch Text
items.description: Text torn into shifting horizontal slices by two offset copies. The copies are pseudo elements, so the accessible text is the plain string. Pure CSS: server-safe, and the loop stops under reduced motion.

items.name: glow-grid
items.title: Glow Grid
items.description: A quiet hairline grid that lights up around the pointer, as if a torch were held over it. The pointer only moves two CSS variables once per frame; the light is a masked copy of the grid. Touch and keyboard users see the light at its resting point.

items.name: gradient-border
items.title: Gradient Border
items.description: A card surface whose edge is a conic gradient that orbits the border. The fill and the edge are two backgrounds on one element (`padding-box` over `border-box`), so there is no extra markup and content needs no z-index. Server-component safe.

items.name: gradient-text
items.title: Gradient Text
items.description: Text filled with a slowly drifting multi-stop gradient. Pure CSS, server component safe.

items.name: grainient
items.title: Grainient
items.description: A drifting, grainy colour field. Soft colour fields wander on transform-only loops under a film-grain SVG tile, so the compositor does the work: no canvas, no WebGL, no JavaScript. Server-component safe.

items.name: grid
items.title: Grid
items.description: Equal columns that respond to the grid's own width through container queries, so the same grid works in a sidebar, a dialog or a full page without breakpoints tied to the viewport.

items.name: grid-pattern
items.title: Grid Pattern
items.description: A crisp SVG line grid. The static grid ships no JavaScript; only the animated flat mode mounts a small client part that moves lit cells around between flashes.

items.name: halftone
items.title: Halftone
items.description: A print halftone screen: a rotated grid of dots whose size follows soft pools of light drifting underneath, plus one under the pointer. Canvas, DPR-capped, paused offscreen.

items.name: heading
items.title: Heading
items.description: A heading whose outline level and visual size are chosen separately.

items.name: hero-spotlight
items.title: Hero Spotlight
items.description: A large, soft beam of light that sweeps in from a corner on mount and settles into a static glow. Its resting styles are the final frame, so reduced motion simply shows the settled light. Server-component safe.

items.name: highlight
items.title: Highlight
items.description: Marks every occurrence of a search term with `<mark>`, longest terms first.

items.name: hint-layer
items.title: Coachmark and Hint Layer
items.description: One hint surface for a whole app, ported from the dashboard: anything with `data-hint` (or a `title`) shows a styled hint that follows the pointer, and a keyboard focus shows it under the element. Lines split on newlines; the first is bold when there are several.

items.name: holo-card
items.title: Holo Card
items.description: A holographic foil card for gift cards, loyalty tiers and limited drops. It tilts on springs, shifts an iridescent foil with the viewing angle, lets glitter catch the light around the reflection, and lifts children marked `data-depth="<px>"` off the surface.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A preview card for sighted pointer and keyboard users. It supplements a link that already works on its own, so it never holds content that is unreachable elsewhere.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: An icon control with a required accessible name.

items.name: image-compare
items.title: Image Compare
items.description: A before/after reveal. The divider is a `slider`: drag it, click anywhere, or use arrows, Page keys, Home and End. Position is written to a CSS variable, not React state.

items.name: image-trail
items.title: Image Trail
items.description: A region where moving the pointer leaves a trail of images that pop in and fade along the path. A fixed pool of image elements is recycled through WAAPI animations, so a long session never grows the DOM or touches React state. Touch scrolling stays untouched: a tap drops an image instead.

items.name: inbox-list
items.title: Inbox List
items.description: A triage list in the style of a product inbox: one selectable row per thread, with unread weight and a dot. A single-select listbox, so arrow keys move and Enter or Space selects.

items.name: incident-timeline
items.title: Incident Timeline
items.description: The updates posted for one incident, newest first, on a single rail. Server-safe.

items.name: infinite-list
items.title: Infinite List
items.description: Loads the next page when a sentinel scrolls into view. Loading is announced politely, and a button keeps the list usable without scrolling.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline Edit
items.description: Text that becomes an input when activated. Enter saves, Escape cancels and focus always returns to the text, so keyboard users never lose their place.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field with adornments and a clear button.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: The surface of a text field without the input: hosts chips, segments, buttons and native inputs side by side and shows one focus halo for all of them. Server-component safe.

items.name: insight-list
items.title: Insight List
items.description: A stream of findings, "what changed", each with a direction, a written severity and a bar for the size of its impact. Long lists fold behind a disclosure button.

items.name: integration-card
items.title: Integration Card
items.description: One integration in a directory: logo, name, a line of copy and a connect toggle.

items.name: invite-members
items.title: Invite Members
items.description: Email chips plus a role and a send button: the invite row of a members page.

items.name: iridescence
items.title: Iridescence
items.description: A pearlescent surface whose sheen slides as if the light source moved. Stacked gradients in the paper colors, animated through `background-position`. Pure CSS, server safe.

items.name: json-viewer
items.title: JSON Viewer
items.description: Collapsible, syntax-colored view of any JSON-like value. Each container is a native toggle.

items.name: kanban-board
items.title: Kanban Board
items.description: Columns of cards that move by pointer drag or keyboard (Space to lift, arrows to move, Space to drop, Escape to cancel), with every step announced.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key or shortcut. Server-safe; only platform-aware keys hydrate a tiny client part.

items.name: key-value
items.title: Key Value
items.description: A single labelled value on one row, with an optional copy action.

items.name: keyboard-shortcuts-dialog
items.title: Keyboard Shortcuts Dialog
items.description: A searchable cheat sheet of keyboard shortcuts, summoned with `?`.

items.name: knob
items.title: Knob
items.description: A rotary control on the WAI-ARIA slider pattern. Drag up or down to turn it, or use the arrow, Page, Home and End keys. The arc fills along a 270 degree sweep.

items.name: kpi-strip
items.title: KPI Strip
items.description: A row of readouts separated by hairlines. Items wrap when space runs out and the dividers follow the wrap, so no row starts with a stray rule. Server-safe.

items.name: leaderboard
items.title: Leaderboard
items.description: A ranked list with value bars, podium rings for the top three and movement markers.

items.name: lens
items.title: Lens
items.description: A round magnifier that follows the pointer over an image or any content. The magnified copy is a clipped, scaled clone driven by pointer CSS variables, so it costs no re-renders; the clone is inert and hidden from assistive tech.

items.name: light-cone
items.title: Light Cone
items.description: A stage light: a thin glowing bar near the top casts a soft cone of light down onto the content. Opens once on mount, then rests; its resting styles are the final frame. Server-component safe.

items.name: light-rays
items.title: Light Rays
items.description: Soft shafts of light falling from above, each swaying and breathing on its own loop like light through moving leaves. Seeded, transform and opacity only. Server-component safe.

items.name: lightbox
items.title: Lightbox
items.description: A full-screen image viewer on the native <dialog>: wheel, double-click and keyboard zoom around the pointer, drag to pan while zoomed, swipe or arrow keys between images.

items.name: lightning
items.title: Lightning
items.description: Seeded SVG bolts that strike in turn with a double flicker and a sky flash. The flashes are CSS opacity keyframes, so nothing runs in JavaScript. Server-component safe.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: An inline link with an underline that sits clear of descenders, and a safe external mode.

items.name: liquid-glass
items.title: Liquid Glass
items.description: A web approximation of Apple's Liquid Glass: a surface that refracts what sits behind it through a curved rim, splits colour at the edge, and catches a light that orbits toward the pointer. Chromium gets true refraction through an SVG displacement filter in `backdrop-filter`; other browsers get frosted glass; `prefers-reduced-transparency` gets an opaque surface.

items.name: live-cursor-badge
items.title: Live Cursor Badge
items.description: A collaborator's pointer with a name flag, for multiplayer canvases. Position updates glide on a spring; the colour is derived from the name so it stays stable per person. Server-safe.

items.name: log-viewer
items.title: Log Viewer
items.description: A windowed log stream with level filters, search highlighting and tail-follow.

items.name: logo-cloud
items.title: Logo Cloud
items.description: A quiet strip or grid of customer marks.

items.name: loyalty-meter
items.title: Loyalty Meter
items.description: Reward points with the current tier, markers for every tier and the gap to the next one.

items.name: magnet-lines
items.title: Magnet Lines
items.description: A grid of short strokes that all turn to face the pointer, like iron filings around a magnet. Decorative: hidden from assistive tech, and frozen under reduced motion.

items.name: magnetic
items.title: Magnetic
items.description: Pulls its child toward a nearby pointer and springs it home when the pointer moves away.

items.name: markdown-text
items.title: Markdown Text
items.description: A tiny, safe markdown renderer for assistant answers: paragraphs, headings, emphasis, inline and fenced code, lists, quotes, tables and links. It builds React elements from a small parser, never HTML strings, and survives half-streamed input. Server-component safe.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: An infinite, seamless strip of content. Runs on the compositor via the Web Animations API, eases to a stop on hover, and becomes a plain scrollable strip under reduced motion.

items.name: mask-reveal
items.title: Mask Reveal
items.description: A surface with a second layer hidden beneath it, uncovered through a soft circular window that follows the pointer and swells open on hover.

items.name: masonry
items.title: Masonry
items.description: Packs items into the shortest column while keeping DOM order, so Tab and screen readers move through items as authored. Until measured (and on the server) it falls back to CSS columns.

items.name: member-list
items.title: Member List
items.description: People with access: avatar, name, email, role and status, with room for row actions. Status is always written out, never colour alone. Server-safe.

items.name: mention-input
items.title: Mention Input
items.description: A textarea that suggests people after `@`. Known mentions are tinted in place through a mirrored backdrop, so the text stays a plain, editable string.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: An APG menubar: one tab stop, arrow keys between menus, menus that follow the pointer.

items.name: mesh-gradient
items.title: Mesh Gradient
items.description: A multi-point gradient mesh: each control point is a soft pool of color that blends with its neighbours and wanders slowly around its anchor. Pure CSS, server-component safe.

items.name: meteors
items.title: Meteors
items.description: Meteors streaking across the frame on CSS keyframes alone. Every meteor passes a seeded point halfway through its flight, so coverage is even at any angle, and that midpoint is the static frame shown under reduced motion. Server-component safe.

items.name: metric-compare
items.title: Metric Compare
items.description: Two periods of one metric, with paired bars and the change between them.

items.name: mini-cart
items.title: Mini Cart
items.description: Header cart button with a count, opening a compact popover of lines, subtotal and checkout.

items.name: mobile-nav-sheet
items.title: Mobile Nav Sheet
items.description: A hamburger that opens a side sheet with drill-down navigation. Each nested level turns in from the edge; Back returns focus to the item that opened it.

items.name: modal-stack
items.title: Modal Stack
items.description: A dialog that can open another dialog on top of itself. Nest a ModalStack inside a ModalStackContent: the parent recedes, the child takes focus, and Escape peels one layer off.

items.name: mode-toggle
items.title: Mode Toggle
items.description: Light, dark or follow the system. It only reports the choice; apply it with `data-theme` on the root. The cycle button turns its glyph in on every change.

items.name: moire
items.title: Moire
items.description: Two identical hairline patterns drifting against each other, so large interference fringes bloom and dissolve between them. Two gradients, transform only. Server-component safe.

items.name: morph-dialog
items.title: Morph Dialog
items.description: A card that becomes its own dialog. The trigger's container, image and title travel to their places in the dialog and back, through the View Transitions API where available and a FLIP animation elsewhere. Underneath it is a native modal <dialog>: focus is trapped and returned, the page is inert and its scroll locked, Escape closes. Reduced motion crossfades instead.

items.name: morphing-text
items.title: Morphing Text
items.description: Melts one word into the next: two layers cross-blur while an SVG alpha-threshold filter fuses their edges into one liquid shape. Under reduced motion the first text stays put.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi Select
items.description: A filterable multi-select: chips in the field, a multi-selectable listbox below. Enter toggles the active option and keeps the list open for the next pick.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Site navigation with disclosure panels (not an ARIA menu: links stay links). Panels open on hover intent or click, slide in from the direction of travel, and an indicator follows the open trigger.

items.name: nested-drawer
items.title: Nested Drawer
items.description: A drawer that can push further drawers over itself, for drill-in flows (cart, then address, then a map). Each parent slides back and dims while a child is open.

items.name: newsletter-form
items.title: Newsletter Form
items.description: Email capture with inline validation, a busy state and an announced confirmation.

items.name: noise
items.title: Noise
items.description: Film grain from an inline SVG turbulence tile: no network request, no canvas, no JavaScript. Server-component safe.

items.name: notification-center
items.title: Notification Center
items.description: A bell that opens a non-modal panel of notifications with All and Unread views. Opening an item marks it read; the header can clear everything at once.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number Field
items.description: A spinbutton that formats with Intl in the user's locale and steps from the keyboard, the wheel-free buttons, or press-and-hold.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number Ticker
items.description: Counts up to a number when it scrolls into view, and animates every later change. `count` rewrites a single text node through a spring; `roll` spins per-digit wheels like an odometer. Both reserve their final width, use tabular figures and expose only the final value to assistive tech.

items.name: onboarding-checklist
items.title: Onboarding Checklist
items.description: A setup checklist with a progress ring. The first unfinished step starts open; each step is a disclosure, so its detail and action stay one keypress away.

items.name: option-tile
items.title: Option Tile
items.description: A native radio drawn as a tile with a preview. Give tiles the same `name` inside a `role="radiogroup"` and the browser supplies arrow-key selection and form submission. Server-component safe.

items.name: orb
items.title: Orb
items.description: A lit sphere with a slow inner swirl and an orbit light sweeping its rim. Layers of radial and conic gradients turned on transform-only loops. Pure CSS, server safe.

items.name: orbit-rings
items.title: Orbit Rings
items.description: Hairline concentric rings, each with a conic light sweeping around it at its own pace, alternating direction. Transform-only. Server safe.

items.name: orbiting-circles
items.title: Orbiting Circles
items.description: Satellites circling a centre on an orbit, each kept upright by a counter-rotation. Stack several with different radii for a system. Pure CSS: server-safe, and still under reduced motion.

items.name: order-summary
items.title: Order Summary
items.description: Checkout line items and totals, collapsible on small screens.

items.name: order-tracker
items.title: Order Tracker
items.description: Ordered → shipped → delivered progress, with the current step ringed.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: The title block of a page: breadcrumb, title, description, meta and page actions. Server-safe.

items.name: pager
items.title: Pager
items.description: Previous and next links at the end of an article or docs page.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Server-safe in link mode: with `getHref` it renders plain anchors and ships no JavaScript.

items.name: panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: A dashboard surface: header, body and footer parts on one of three materials. It names itself after its `PanelTitle`, and lays itself out in a `PanelGrid` through `span`.

items.name: panel-grid
items.title: Panel Grid
items.description: A 12-column dashboard grid that responds to its own width, not the viewport's, so it works the same in a sidebar layout, a dialog or a full page. Children choose their columns with `data-span` (wide containers) and `data-span-md` (medium); `Panel` sets both from its `span` props. Below 40rem every child takes the full row. Server-safe.

items.name: parallax-layers
items.title: Parallax Layers
items.description: A scene of stacked layers that drift at different speeds as it scrolls through the viewport (and optionally as the pointer moves), for depth without WebGL. Progress is written to CSS variables once per frame, only while the scene is on screen.

items.name: particles
items.title: Particles
items.description: A canvas particle field: drifting, twinkling dots with optional links and pointer magnetism. DPR-aware, sized by ResizeObserver, paused offscreen and in hidden tabs, and drawn as one still frame under reduced motion. Colors are read from CSS, so the field follows theme changes.

items.name: password-field
items.title: Password Field
items.description: A password input with a reveal toggle, an optional strength meter, live requirement checks and a Caps Lock hint.

items.name: payment-method-selector
items.title: Payment Method Selector
items.description: Payment options as a stack of radio rows. The chosen row expands to reveal its fields, the way Shopify and Stripe present cards, wallets and pay-later side by side.

items.name: permission-matrix
items.title: Permission Matrix
items.description: Roles across, permissions down, a checkbox or switch in every cell. A WAI-ARIA grid: one Tab stop, arrows move between cells, Home and End go to the row ends, Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End to the corners, Space toggles. Each cell is named by its permission and role headers.

items.name: phone-input
items.title: Phone Input
items.description: A national number field with a searchable country code. It formats as you type, accepts pasted international numbers and reports E.164. No phone metadata is bundled.

items.name: pin-input
items.title: Pin Input
items.description: One-time code entry with paste and autofill.

items.name: pixel-transition
items.title: Pixel Transition
items.description: Swaps two faces of a card through a field of pixels that flicker on in random order, then off again over the new face. Tapping toggles on touch screens; reduced motion swaps instantly.

items.name: plan-badge
items.title: Plan Badge
items.description: The plan a workspace is on, for menus, headers and settings rows. Server-safe.

items.name: plan-summary
items.title: Plan Summary
items.description: The plan a workspace is on today, for the billing settings page. Server-safe.

items.name: plasma
items.title: Plasma
items.description: Classic sum-of-sines plasma, computed into a buffer one eighth the size of the section and smoothed by the browser on the way up, so it is soft, cheap and on-palette.

items.name: plate
items.title: Plate
items.description: An inset, framed area inside a surface: a chart well, a preview or a placeholder. Server-safe.

items.name: pointer-light
items.title: Pointer Light
items.description: A light that follows the cursor over any surface: an image, a chart, a panel. Unlike a spotlight card it brings no styling of its own and sits over the content, not behind it. One style write per frame, no re-renders.

items.name: pointer-trail
items.title: Pointer Trail
items.description: A ribbon of light that follows the pointer across the area and tapers away behind it. Drawn on a canvas only while there is a trail, so an idle area costs nothing. Off under reduced motion and for touch.

items.name: poll
items.title: Poll
items.description: A single-choice poll: radios and a Vote button, then animated result bars.

items.name: popconfirm
items.title: Popconfirm
items.description: A small anchored confirmation for low-stakes destructive actions on a single item.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Owns the open state of a non-modal dialog anchored to its trigger. Renders no element.

items.name: presence-avatars
items.title: Presence Avatars
items.description: Who else is viewing: overlapping faces with a live ring for the active ones and a +N chip. Every face carries its name and state as text. Server-safe.

items.name: price
items.title: Price
items.description: Locale-aware money with compare-at and savings.

items.name: price-range-slider
items.title: Price Range Slider
items.description: A two-thumb price filter with synced inputs and an optional price histogram.

items.name: pricing-card
items.title: Pricing Card
items.description: One marketing pricing tier: name, big price, call to action and feature list.

items.name: pricing-table
items.title: Pricing Table
items.description: A row of plan cards driven by a monthly / yearly toggle that shows the best yearly saving.

items.name: pricing-toggle
items.title: Pricing Toggle
items.description: Monthly / yearly billing switch with a savings tag on the yearly option.

items.name: prism
items.title: Prism
items.description: A glass prism splitting a single beam into a fan of paper-colored light. The glass carries a slowly turning conic caustic; each band of the fan breathes on its own loop. Server safe.

items.name: product-badge
items.title: Product Badge
items.description: Merchandising label for product tiles: New, Sale, Bestseller, Sold out and friends.

items.name: product-banner
items.title: Product Banner
items.description: An inline banner inside the product: a plan limit, a migration, a beta. Not a page-top announcement bar; it sits in the content flow and can carry an action.

items.name: product-card
items.title: Product Card
items.description: A merchandising tile. Server-safe: the hover image, quick-add reveal and stretched link are CSS, and only the wishlist and quick-add buttons hydrate.

items.name: product-compare
items.title: Product Compare
items.description: Side-by-side spec table. Rows where every product matches can be hidden, and rows that differ are tinted so the eye lands on what actually separates the options.

items.name: product-gallery
items.title: Product Gallery
items.description: Product media: a scroll-snap stage (swipe on touch), arrows, thumbnails, keyboard support, hover zoom on fine pointers and a fullscreen lightbox built on Dialog.

items.name: product-spin
items.title: Product Spin
items.description: A 360° product viewer built from an image sequence. Drag, fling, scroll, scrub the dial or use the arrow keys to turn it; frames stream in coarse-to-fine behind an orbit progress ring.

items.name: product-tabs
items.title: Product Tabs
items.description: Product details, shipping and returns as tabs, or as an accordion of native disclosures.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A linear progress bar. The fill moves with a transform, so value changes glide without layout. `useId` is available in Server Components, so this stays RSC-safe.

items.name: progressive-blur
items.title: Progressive Blur
items.description: An edge that blurs what scrolls under it more and more toward the side, like a lens falling out of focus. Stacked backdrop filters, each masked to its own band. Place it in a positioned container; server-safe and static.

items.name: project-card
items.title: Project Card
items.description: A project tile for a dashboard home: identity, domain, and the last deploy. Server-safe.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt Input
items.description: The box a question is typed into. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, and Enter while an IME is composing picks the candidate instead. While an answer streams, send turns into stop.

items.name: prose
items.title: Prose
items.description: Typesets rendered HTML you do not control, such as Markdown or CMS output: headings, lists, quotes, code, tables and media, with vertical rhythm.

items.name: qr-code
items.title: QR Code
items.description: An SVG QR Code from a dependency-free encoder (byte mode, versions 1-40, all ECC levels).

items.name: quantity-stepper
items.title: Quantity Stepper
items.description: An APG spinbutton flanked by − / + buttons that auto-repeat, accelerating, while held.

items.name: quick-view
items.title: Quick View
items.description: A product preview dialog: compact gallery, SKU-aware options, quantity and add to cart.

items.name: quota-bar
items.title: Quota Bar
items.description: A usage meter against a plan limit, turning amber near it and red past it. Server-safe.

items.name: radial-burst
items.title: Radial Burst
items.description: A slow-turning sunburst: a repeating conic gradient on an oversized disc, faded toward its rim so it reads as light rather than a pattern. Server-component safe.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Native radios sharing one `name`, so arrow keys, Tab-to-selected and form submission come from the browser. Pass a string union as `T` to type `value` and `onValueChange`.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Star rating. Without `onValueChange` it is a server-safe display; with it, a native radio group with arrow-key selection and hover preview.

items.name: reactions-bar
items.title: Reactions Bar
items.description: Emoji counts under a comment or update. Each pill is a toggle; the add button picks more.

items.name: readout
items.title: Readout
items.description: A labelled figure: label, big value, delta and caption. Rendered as a description list so the label stays paired with the value for screen readers. Server-safe.

items.name: recently-viewed
items.title: Recently Viewed
items.description: A compact, scroll-snapping rail of products the shopper looked at, with paging buttons.

items.name: reel
items.title: Reel
items.description: A horizontal strip that scrolls instead of wrapping, with snap points and a thin bar.

items.name: referral-card
items.title: Referral Card
items.description: Give-and-get offer with a copyable personal link and the native share sheet where available.

items.name: relative-time
items.title: Relative Time
items.description: “3 minutes ago”, kept fresh while mounted, with the absolute time as a tooltip.

items.name: responsive-dialog
items.title: Responsive Dialog
items.description: One dialog API, two surfaces: a centred dialog on wide screens and a draggable bottom sheet on narrow ones. The open state survives crossing the breakpoint.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: Reveals its content as it scrolls into view. The server always renders the content visible: the hidden pre-state is applied on the client before first paint, and only to elements that start offscreen, so nothing flashes, and nothing stays hidden without JavaScript.

items.name: review-card
items.title: Review Card
items.description: A single customer review: stars, short title, body, purchase details and a helpful vote.

items.name: review-form
items.title: Review Form
items.description: Star rating, optional title and body with validation, a busy state and confirmation.

items.name: review-summary
items.title: Review Summary
items.description: Average, total and a 5→1 star distribution whose rows can filter the review list.

items.name: ribbons
items.title: Ribbons
items.description: Soft ribbons that chase the pointer through the section and coil on a slow figure-eight when it leaves. Each ribbon is a spring chain drawn with a tapering stroke. Canvas, DPR-capped.

items.name: ripple
items.title: Ripple
items.description: Adds material ink to its child: a wave from the pointer on press, or from the centre on Enter and Space. Waves live outside React and remove themselves once they fade.

items.name: ripple-grid
items.title: Ripple Grid
items.description: A grid of hairline cells with a ring of light rippling out from one point. Every cell runs the same keyframes, delayed by its distance from the origin, so the wave is pure CSS. Server safe.

items.name: roadmap-board
items.title: Roadmap Board
items.description: A public roadmap in three columns: now, next, later. Server-safe.

items.name: rotating-text
items.title: Rotating Text
items.description: Cycles through words in a fixed-width slot with a slide, blur or 3D flip. Only one state update per word; the motion itself is CSS. Pauses on hover, on focus, offscreen and in hidden tabs.

items.name: row-splitter
items.title: Row Splitter
items.description: Two panes with a draggable, keyboard-operable separator between them (the WAI-ARIA window splitter pattern). Arrows move it, Home and End jump to the limits, Enter or a double-click restores the default. Dragging writes to a CSS variable, so the panes re-layout without a React render per frame.

items.name: scale-input
items.title: Scale Input
items.description: A numbered rating scale (NPS, Likert, 1 to 5) built on native radios, so arrow keys, forms and required validation work as they do for any radio group.

items.name: scramble-text
items.title: Scramble Text
items.description: Decodes text from random glyphs, left to right. Every original character stays in place (transparent while scrambled) with its stand-in painted over it, so the width never changes and line breaks never move. Frames are written to attributes, not React state.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Native scrolling with slim, themeable overlay scrollbars. The viewport keeps wheel, touch, keyboard and find-in-page behaviour; only the visual bar is replaced, so it is aria-hidden.

items.name: scroll-progress
items.title: Scroll Progress
items.description: A hairline bar that fills as the page, or one scroll container, is read. The fill is a `scaleX` written once per scroll frame. It never animates on its own: the fill follows the reader's scroll one to one with no easing, so it reads the same under reduced motion. Decorative, so hidden from assistive tech.

items.name: scroll-stack
items.title: Scroll Stack
items.description: Cards that pin one after another as you scroll, each settling a few pixels below the last so the edges of the deck peek out, while buried cards recede: smaller, darker, tipped back. Scroll-driven CSS animations do the work where supported; elsewhere a passive scroll listener writes the same progress variable once per frame. Children must be `ScrollStackItem`s.

items.name: scroll-text
items.title: Scroll Text
items.description: A paragraph whose words fill in from faint to full as it scrolls through the viewport. Runs on CSS scroll-driven animations where supported, with zero JavaScript per frame; elsewhere a passive scroll listener writes a single progress variable while the paragraph is on screen.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search Field
items.description: A searchbox with clear, shortcut and debounce.

items.name: search-select
items.title: Search Select
items.description: A select for long lists: the popup opens with a search box that filters as you type.

items.name: secret-input
items.title: Secret Input
items.description: A password-style field for tokens and secrets, with reveal and optional copy.

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: A full-width band of the page with vertical rhythm. Pair with `aria-labelledby` pointing at its heading so it is announced as a named region.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: A single-choice radiogroup with a thumb that springs between options. Built on native radios, so arrow keys select and the value submits with a form.

items.name: segmented-nav
items.title: Segmented Nav
items.description: Page-level navigation styled as a segmented track. Unlike SegmentedControl (a radio group that changes a value), items here are links to places, marked with `aria-current="page"`.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: An APG select-only combobox: focus stays on the trigger and the active option is conveyed with `aria-activedescendant`, so screen readers announce it without moving focus.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline divider, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: series-swatch
items.title: Series Swatch
items.description: Carries a series' identity beside its label, so the label itself stays in the text colour. The mark is decorative; the children are the accessible label. Server-safe.

items.name: session-list
items.title: Session List
items.description: Past conversations, newest first, grouped by day, with the open one marked.

items.name: settings-nav
items.title: Settings Nav
items.description: The section list beside a settings page. Vertical in wide layouts; in a narrow container it turns into a scrolling row of pills. Server-safe.

items.name: shimmer-button
items.title: Shimmer Button
items.description: A call-to-action whose border carries a travelling light, with a sheen sweeping across the surface. CSS-only animation that pauses offscreen and turns static under reduced motion.

items.name: shiny-text
items.title: Shiny Text
items.description: A band of light that sweeps across text through `background-clip: text`. Pure CSS, server component safe, and still under reduced motion.

items.name: shipment-timeline
items.title: Shipment Timeline
items.description: Carrier scan history, newest first, with the latest event emphasised.

items.name: shortcut-table
items.title: Shortcut Table
items.description: A reference sheet of keyboard shortcuts. Server-safe.

items.name: show
items.title: Show / Hide
items.description: Renders its children only within a width range, in CSS alone, so it works on the server and never flashes. The wrapper has `display: contents` and adds no box.

items.name: shuffle-text
items.title: Shuffle Text
items.description: Each character is a tiny slot-machine reel that spins through random glyphs and lands on its letter, staggered across the word. The reels are CSS transitions on `transform`.

items.name: sidebar-nav
items.title: Sidebar Nav
items.description: Sections, items, groups and a current-page mark.

items.name: signature-pad
items.title: Signature Pad
items.description: A canvas for signing with a mouse, pen or finger. Strokes are smoothed and thin out with speed; Undo and Clear are real buttons. Ink follows the theme's text color.

items.name: silk
items.title: Silk
items.description: Soft folds of light sliding over each other like draped fabric. Three blurred, repeating gradient sheets drift at different speeds, with a slow sheen on top. Pure CSS, server safe.

items.name: size-guide
items.title: Size Guide
items.description: A "Size guide" link that opens the measurement table in a dialog.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder for content that is still loading. Purely visual and hidden from assistive technology: wrap a set of them in `SkeletonGroup` to announce the loading state once.

items.name: skip-link
items.title: Skip Link
items.description: The first stop for keyboard users: hidden until focused, then jumps past the navigation. Focus is moved by hand so the link also works under hash routers, where following `#main` would change the route.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Single or multi-thumb with marks.

items.name: spacer
items.title: Spacer
items.description: Empty room: a fixed gap, or a flexible one that pushes siblings apart.

items.name: speed-dial
items.title: Speed Dial
items.description: A floating action button that expands into a few related actions.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An indeterminate loading indicator. Keeps turning under reduced motion, only slower.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split Button
items.description: A primary action fused with a menu button for its alternatives.

items.name: split-flap
items.title: Split Flap
items.description: A split-flap departure board. Each cell is two halves and two hinged flaps; on change the upper flap falls while the lower one swings down behind it, one glyph at a time.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight Card
items.description: A paper sheet lit by a soft light that follows the pointer, edge included. CSS-driven, no re-renders.

items.name: squares-grid
items.title: Squares Grid
items.description: A hairline grid that scrolls steadily in one direction, lighting the cell under the pointer as it passes. Canvas, DPR-capped, paused offscreen and still under reduced motion.

items.name: stack
items.title: Stack
items.description: Children in one column or one row, evenly spaced.

items.name: star-border
items.title: Star Border
items.description: A pill whose edge is lit by two soft points of light travelling in opposite directions along its top and bottom. Pure CSS and server-safe; the light stops under reduced motion.

items.name: starfield
items.title: Starfield
items.description: Flying through a field of stars: points stream outward from the centre and stretch into warp streaks as they pass. Canvas, DPR-capped, paused offscreen, a still sky under reduced motion.

items.name: starry-sky
items.title: Starry Sky
items.description: A quiet night sky: seeded stars that twinkle at their own pace, crossed now and then by a shooting star with a fading tail. Canvas, DPR-capped, paused offscreen.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A KPI: label, value, a signed change and an optional sparkline. Rendered as a description list so the label and value stay paired for screen readers.

items.name: state-panel
items.title: State Panel
items.description: What a panel shows instead of its content: empty, loading, error, unavailable or no access. Announced as a status, busy while loading, with an icon, a title and the way forward. Server-safe.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: Status Dot
items.description: A status marker that always carries its meaning in text and shape, never in colour alone.

items.name: status-indicator
items.title: Status Indicator
items.description: Service health for one system: a shaped dot plus words. Server-safe.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Progress through a sequence of steps, horizontally or as a vertical timeline.

items.name: sticky
items.title: Sticky
items.description: Sticks to an edge of its scroll container and reports when it is stuck, so a header can gain a surface and shadow only once content scrolls beneath it.

items.name: sticky-add-to-cart
items.title: Sticky Add To Cart
items.description: A slim bar that keeps the buy button in reach once the shopper scrolls past the real one.

items.name: sticky-reveal
items.title: Sticky Reveal
items.description: A section that pins while you scroll through it, opening a framed media window to full bleed and then fading its overlay in. Under reduced motion it renders the open state.

items.name: stock-indicator
items.title: Stock Indicator
items.description: Availability as a colored dot plus words, so color is never the only signal. Server-safe.

items.name: store-locator-list
items.title: Store Locator List
items.description: Pickup-store chooser: distance, opening status and per-store stock, sorted by the caller.

items.name: stripes
items.title: Stripes
items.description: Hairline diagonal stripes that scroll along their own axis, like a caution band or a loading surface. One repeating gradient whose position slides by exactly one period per loop. Server-component safe.

items.name: stroke-text
items.title: Stroke Text
items.description: Outlined display type that fills with ink from left to right: on hover, once in view, or scrubbed by scroll. The fill is a pseudo element, so the text is never duplicated in the DOM.

items.name: subscription-selector
items.title: Subscription Selector
items.description: One-time versus subscribe-and-save, following Shopify's selling-plan guidance: one-time is the default, savings are shown as a percentage, each option carries its per-delivery price, and frequency uses radios up to four choices and a select beyond that.

items.name: suggestion-chips
items.title: Suggestion Chips
items.description: Starter questions or follow-ups, one click from being asked. Server-component safe.

items.name: swatch-picker
items.title: Swatch Picker
items.description: Round color swatches as native radios. The legend reads "Color: Sage" so the choice is never conveyed by color alone, and sold-out colors keep a diagonal strike but stay focusable.

items.name: swipe-deck
items.title: Swipe Deck
items.description: A physical deck of cards to fling left (skip) or right (save). Rotation follows the grab point, releases carry their velocity, the next card rises from behind, and every swipe can be undone.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A native checkbox exposed as `role="switch"`: forms, reset and autofill keep working.

items.name: switch-group
items.title: Switch Group
items.description: A settings list: one labelled switch per row, on a single card, reporting what is on.

items.name: switcher
items.title: Switcher
items.description: Children side by side in equal columns, or all stacked once the container is narrower than `threshold`. No breakpoints: it reacts to its own width, wherever it is placed. Each child gets a huge positive basis below the threshold and a huge negative one above, so all wrap or none do.

items.name: table-of-contents
items.title: Table Of Contents
items.description: "On this page" navigation with a scrollspy marker that glides along the rail.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Paper folder tabs, plus underline and pill styles.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A chip for selected filters, keywords and recipients. Server-safe: the remove button only exists when an `onRemove` handler is passed, which already implies a client tree.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: Free-form tags. Enter or a delimiter commits, paste splits on commas and new lines, Backspace on an empty field marks the last tag and a second press removes it.

items.name: team-switcher
items.title: Team Switcher
items.description: A menu button for the active team, listing the others as radio items.

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: Paper Layers: a fixed night-paper sheet; the keyframes live in terminal.css and each line's timing is composed here into --_show, --_type and --_caret. A terminal transcript that types its commands. The typing is pure CSS (`clip-path` stepped per character), so nothing re-renders per frame; screen readers get the full transcript.

items.name: testimonial-card
items.title: Testimonial Card
items.description: A customer quote with attribution, optional stars and company mark.

items.name: text
items.title: Text
items.description: Body text on the type scale, with tone, weight, truncation and line clamping.

items.name: text-highlight
items.title: Text Highlight
items.description: Draws a marker stroke, underline or hand-drawn circle behind inline text when it scrolls into view. The marker and underline wrap across lines with `box-decoration-break: clone`.

items.name: text-pressure
items.title: Text Pressure
items.description: A headline that swells under the pointer: characters near it gain weight and stretch upward, easing back as the pointer leaves. Values are eased per frame and written to CSS variables.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text Reveal
items.description: Reveals text word by word or character by character with a staggered CSS animation. The animation starts from server-rendered markup, so `trigger="mount"` plays before hydration and nothing runs per frame in JavaScript.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A textarea that grows with its content.

items.name: theme-card
items.title: Theme Card
items.description: A theme choice as a radio tile: a miniature app rendered in that theme's real tokens, so even a faint tint registers before it is picked. Server-component safe.

items.name: thought-line
items.title: Thought Line
items.description: The assistant's reasoning line: a breathing sparkle, the current step and a running clock while it works; settled, it reads "Thought for 4.1s" and the steps fold away. The clock writes straight to its node, so ticking never re-renders the conversation.

items.name: threads
items.title: Threads
items.description: A loose bundle of hairline threads that pinch together and fan apart as they drift past. SVG strokes on a seamless, transform-only loop. Server-component safe.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: A surface that tilts in 3D toward the pointer, with a spring-driven reset, an optional glare, and parallax depth for descendants marked `data-depth="<px>"`.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time Picker
items.description: Typed hour and minute segments, each a spinbutton, with an AM/PM segment on 12-hour clocks.

items.name: time-slot-picker
items.title: Time Slot Picker
items.description: Bookable times as a grid of native radios: arrow keys move, taken slots stay visible.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Ordered events along a line, with done, current and upcoming states. Server-safe. Paper Layers: done steps are solid dots on a toned rule, the current step sits in an ink-edged disc, upcoming steps are hollow.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Stacked notifications you can call from anywhere.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button (`aria-pressed`). For formatting bars, filters and view switches. Give icon-only toggles an `aria-label`; it stays the same in both states.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A set of toggle buttons with one tab stop and arrow-key navigation. `single` behaves like a radio set that can be cleared; `multiple` like a row of checkboxes.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: An APG toolbar: one tab stop for the whole bar, arrow keys and Home/End between controls, and focus remembered when tabbing back in.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short help text on hover and focus.

items.name: topbar
items.title: Topbar
items.description: The bar along the top of an app. Server-safe: it only lays out the slots it's given.

items.name: topo-lines
items.title: Topo Lines
items.description: A seeded topographic map: nested, organic contour lines around a few summits, with every fifth line drawn as an index contour. Static SVG, optionally turning very slowly. Server safe.

items.name: tracing-beam
items.title: Tracing Beam
items.description: A rail beside long-form content whose beam grows as you read, its head held at a fixed height on screen. The fill eases behind the scroll with a spring; under reduced motion it tracks the scroll exactly.

items.name: transfer-list
items.title: Transfer List
items.description: Two multi-select lists with move buttons between them. Space checks, Enter moves the checked items across, Ctrl or Cmd+A checks everything visible. Double-click moves one item.

items.name: tree-select
items.title: Tree Select
items.description: A select whose options are a tree, following the APG tree view pattern: arrows walk and fold branches, Enter picks, Escape closes.

items.name: tree-view
items.title: Tree View
items.description: A hierarchical list following the WAI-ARIA tree pattern: arrows move and open, Home/End jump, `*` expands siblings, typing finds a node, Space selects or checks.

items.name: trial-countdown
items.title: Trial Countdown
items.description: Time left on a trial as a draining ring, with room for an upgrade action. Server-safe.

items.name: true-focus
items.title: True Focus
items.description: Blurs every word but one and frames the sharp word with four corner brackets that glide to the next. Under reduced motion every word stays sharp and nothing cycles.

items.name: truncate-text
items.title: Truncate Text
items.description: Single-line truncation that responds to its container. In `middle` mode the head shrinks with an ellipsis while the tail stays whole, so `invoice-2026-03….pdf` keeps its extension. The DOM always holds the full string, so screen readers and copy-paste get all of it.

items.name: trust-badges
items.title: Trust Badges
items.description: Short reassurance points (secure checkout, returns, shipping) for product and cart pages.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types and deletes a list of words behind a cursor. Characters are written straight to a text node, so a running typewriter never re-renders. It idles while offscreen or in a hidden tab.

items.name: upsell-card
items.title: Upsell Card
items.description: A one-tap add-on offer for cart drawers and order summaries.

items.name: uptime-bars
items.title: Uptime Bars
items.description: A status page strip: one bar per day, worst state wins. Bars are a roving list, so arrow keys walk the days and the readout under the strip follows focus or hover.

items.name: usage-meter
items.title: Usage Meter
items.description: Quota consumption as a `meter`, with thresholds and an optional per-category breakdown.

items.name: user-menu
items.title: User Menu
items.description: The account avatar in a top bar, opening a menu with a who-am-I header.

items.name: variable-proximity
items.title: Variable Proximity
items.description: Inline text whose variable font axes respond to pointer distance character by character, so a sentence ripples in weight, width or slant as the pointer passes over it.

items.name: variant-picker
items.title: Variant Picker
items.description: A single option of a product (color, size, material) as native radios inside a fieldset.

items.name: virtual-list
items.title: Virtual List
items.description: Renders thousands of fixed-height rows by mounting only the visible window. Rows keep `aria-setsize` and `aria-posinset`, so screen readers still announce the full length.

items.name: visually-hidden
items.title: Visually Hidden
items.description: Read by screen readers, invisible on screen: labels, live text and table captions.

items.name: vortex
items.title: Vortex
items.description: A slow whirlpool of light: particles spiral inward, faster near the eye, leaving fading trails, and are reborn at the rim. Canvas, DPR-capped, paused offscreen, a still spiral under reduced motion.

items.name: watermark
items.title: Watermark
items.description: Tiles a faint, rotated text mark over its children. The mark is hidden from assistive tech.

items.name: waves
items.title: Waves
items.description: Layered SVG swells that roll across the edge of a section. Each layer is a seamless double period that translates on its own compositor-only loop. Server-component safe.

items.name: wavy-lines
items.title: Wavy Lines
items.description: Evenly spaced contour-like lines flowing on layered sine waves, bending apart around the pointer like water around a finger. Canvas, DPR-capped, paused offscreen.

items.name: webhook-log
items.title: Webhook Log
items.description: Recent webhook deliveries; each row discloses its request and response bodies.

items.name: wishlist-button
items.title: Wishlist Button
items.description: A heart toggle whose activation pops with a CSS-only ring and particle burst.

items.name: workspace-switcher
items.title: Workspace Switcher
items.description: The workspace name at the top of a sidebar. Opens a searchable list: the field is an ARIA combobox, so arrows move through matches and Enter switches.

items.name: kitgrid-lib
items.title: kitgrid lib
items.description: Shared utils, hooks, primitives and provider the kitgrid components import.

items.name: kitgrid-theme
items.title: kitgrid theme
items.description: Design tokens, base styles and the Tailwind v4 kg theme. Import kitgrid.css before tailwindcss.
